resources.string: Reads the address bar in your browsers, so browser time can be split by site. Only the domain is kept, such as youtube.com. Nothing else on screen is read.

Keeps your app limits. It is told which app is in front, and covers it when it is over a limit. While limits are on it also covers lightcurve\'s own pages in Settings, so they can\'t be switched off in a moment. Nothing is kept or sent.
